text_001: E bibliografia aki ta parti di un proseso pa investigá trabou di e outor Wilfrido Ortega. Apesar di ta menshoná diferente biaha komo un di e outornan mas produktivo di Kòrsou, no ta tin un lista kompletu, aksesibel, di kiko tur Wilfrido a produsí.
text_002: Kórsou ta tin mas outor ku a bende nan bukinan di porta pa porta i ku a skibi novelita. Amador Nita, Tuyuchi, Guillermo Rosario, Nilo Kleinmoedig, Edward de Jongh ta algun di nan. E echo ku Wilfrido a skibi solamente na Papiamentu, a publiká, ilustrá i a distribuí su bukinan di un forma struktural for di 1958 te ku 2013, ta un di e rasonnan. E falta di informashon ku tin di e trabou di Wilfrido Ortega, esei a chispa e kuriosidat.
text_003: Aparte di duna un bista den e produktividat di Wilfrido, Nifa ke kontestá diferente pregunta mas;
text_004: Kiko tabata e balor di Wilfrido Ortega su trabou pa desaroyo di idioma i literatura Papiamentu?
text_005: Ki impakto Wilfrido su konsistensia ta tin pa e komunidat di Kòrsou?
text_006: Kiko di kombibensia di tur tempu por saka for di e storianan di Wilfrido?
text_007: Pa por hasi esaki mester a kompilá un bibliografia di e publikashonnan di Wilfrido i tambe sa na unda por haña nan.
text_009: E bibliografia digital aki ta resultado di diferente trayekto di kapasitashon personal ku Nifa a partisipá na dje den e último añanan:
text_011: Each One Teach One di Fonds voor CultuurParticipatie. E trayekto aki ta tin komo meta pa traha riba abilidatnan pa redigí i publiká. Durante e trayekto a para ketu na e publikashon ‘Destino di Amor’ skibí pa Ortega.
text_012: Caribbean Digital Scholarship Summer Institute. E trayekto aki ta tin komo meta kon pa publiká digital. Durante e trayekto a traha entre otro ku e plataforma GitHub pa por presentá e.m. archivo. Pa a asistí na e trayekto Digitall Caribbean d.k.k. Cultuurfonds Caribisch Gebied a ko-finansiá e biahe pa Jamaica durante e proyekto Digital Connections.
text_013: Nifa Ansano ta un outor kurioso pa e temanan ku e ta skibi, pero tambe pa historia di Kòrsou, pashoná pa literatura. El a aportá na diferente proyekto pa promové outornan i literatura di Kòrsou. Aktualmente e ta laborá na Fundashon NAAM i ta tesorero di e plataforma pa promove literatura den diaspora patruli.org
text_014: This bibliography is part of an ongoing investigation into the work of author Wilfrido Ortega. Although he has often been described as one of Curaçao’s most prolific writers, there is no complete, accessible list of everything he produced.
text_015: Curaçao has other authors who sold books door to door and wrote short novels. Amador Nita, Tuyuchi, Guillermo Rosario, Nilo Kleinmoedig and Edward de Jongh are among them. One reason for this research is that Wilfrido wrote only in Papiamentu and published, illustrated and distributed his books consistently from 1958 to 2013. The lack of information about his work sparked this curiosity.
text_016: Besides providing an overview of Wilfrido’s productivity, Nifa seeks to answer several other questions:
text_017: What was the value of Wilfrido Ortega’s work for the development of the Papiamentu language and literature?
text_018: What impact did Wilfrido’s consistency have on Curaçao’s community?
text_019: What can his stories tell us about life and social relations across different periods?
text_020: To explore these questions, it was necessary to compile a bibliography of Wilfrido’s publications and identify where they can be found.
text_022: This digital bibliography grew out of several professional development programmes in which Nifa has participated in recent years:
text_023: Each One Teach One, a programme of Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie, focuses on developing editing and publishing skills. During the programme, attention was given to the publication ‘Destino di Amor’ written by Ortega.
text_024: The Caribbean Digital Scholarship Summer Institute focuses on digital publishing. Among other things, the programme involved working with GitHub to present archival material. Cultuurfonds Caribisch Gebied co-financed the trip to Jamaica for Digital Caribbean as part of the Digital Connections project.
text_025: Nifa Ansano is a writer who is curious about the subjects she explores, especially Curaçao’s history, and is passionate about literature. She has contributed to various projects promoting Curaçaoan authors and literature. She currently works at Fundashon NAAM and is treasurer of patruli.org, a platform promoting literature in the diaspora.
